title: GTA6 Fall Absence? IGN Previews Rayman Legends Retold as Platformer Alternative
description: Missing GTA6 this fall? IGN previews Rayman Legends Retold, discussing how the content-packed remake fills the gap for Switch 2 and younger players.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Fall Gaming Landscape Without GTA6

As the fall season approaches, Rockstar's monumental GTA6 continues to dominate global gaming conversations. However, not every platform community is caught in the meteor-like landing of GTA6 this autumn. For instance, the Switch 2 crowd is navigating a different ecosystem, especially considering the continued absence of a new 3D Mario platformer and the fact that Super Mario Bros. Wonder released a couple of years ago. In this context, IGN recently published a preview of *Rayman Legends Retold*, sparking discussions about alternative gaming choices.

## Rayman Legends Retold: A Clean and Content-Packed Remake

According to IGN's preview, *Rayman Legends Retold* is not breaking any new ground—neither visually nor gameplay-wise. But then again, such a revolutionary shift shouldn't realistically be expected since it is, after all, a remake. Instead, what players are getting is a clean remake chock-full of content, blending both new and old elements at a pretty nice value.

The game might be of particular interest to the younger crowd who hasn't played the series before, as well as the Switch 2 audience looking to scratch that platforming itch during a season devoid of certain heavy-hitting releases.

## Industry Context and Market Diversity

Analyzing the broader market, the contrast between massive open-world epics and focused platformers highlights the importance of variety. While games like GTA6 capture the headlines, titles like *Rayman Legends Retold* serve a vital role for players seeking classic, tightly designed platforming challenges. IGN wraps up its preview with a hopeful sentiment: here's hoping this release leads to a brand-new Rayman adventure sooner rather than later.

## Editor's Take

While *Rayman Legends Retold* and GTA6 couldn't be further apart in genre and scope, this contrast highlights the beauty of a diverse gaming market. Remakes like this provide a healthy balance for players looking for classic platforming fun.
